text: Assumption: The provision of the alias Sptr indicates that instances of PublicKey are usually created via factories or loader routines and passed as shared pointers — is this correct?

norm: the provision of the alias sptr indicates that instances of publickey are usually created via factories or loader routines and passed as shared pointers
assumption: The provision of the alias Sptr indicates that instances of PublicKey are usually created via factories or loader routines and passed as shared pointers.
rationale: [SWS_CRYPT_22701] defines Sptr as std::shared_ptr<PublicKey>, but specifies no constructors or creation methods in the payload.

original.text: Annahme: Interpretation: Das Bereitstellen des Alias Sptr dürfte darauf hinweisen, dass Instanzen von PublicKey üblicherweise über Fabriken oder Laderoutinen erzeugt und als Shared Pointer übergeben werden — trifft das zu?
